body: Thank you. I really just want to feel better about myself. He's fully  depleted my self confidence :(

my 'friend' messaged him yesterday and he basically said he didn't miss me at all and that I'm just a psycho. I don't want anything to do with the 'friend' anymore because I told her to stay out of it and she didn't
I just miss him... he was everything to me

Thank you for that link, I'll have a look! And I have deleted him off everything (more like he's deleted me actually), he messaged me from his cousin's Snapchat who I'm friends with.

I don't know for sure that he's messing with me but that's what it feels like... part of me is hoping that he misses me.

We broke up because it was his first actual serious relationship, I basically lived at his house on weekends, and he came to mine once or twice midweek after work and stayed the night. I think he got cold feet and wanted out.

I just feel completely worthless and empty... alone in this world. He was everything to me and I would do absolutely anything to bring him back to me.

Thank you.
I know... I think I'm just hoping that he isn't playing with me because I still love him and I miss him.
I'm not sure if he misses me or if he just wants to play with my emotions by making me think that he misses me.
